buttonTheme.screenTopToBottomTooltip: Span all visible popped Buttons on each monitor along the Angle. Otherwise, span each window separately.
buttonTheme.gradientColorCountTooltip: Choose how many colors the Button Fill gradient uses. Every ordered stop appears from Start through End, and Refill samples this many colors from the current Theme image.
buttonTheme.textColorCountTooltip: Choose how many colors the Button Text gradient uses. One color keeps every label a solid color.

actionTooltips.button-theme.scan: Collect individual colors from scoped action Buttons in this program's open Pop-out and Fan windows. Each Button has its own editable color; editor previews remain excluded.
actionTooltips.button-theme.apply: Apply the listed colors to checked Buttons. Individual color edits apply directly, including to unchecked Buttons. Rescan is required if the open windows changed.
actionTooltips.button-theme.apply-gradient: Apply the Button Fill gradient to scoped Buttons in this program's currently open Pop-outs and Fans, including each Fan surface owner and every member while collapsed or expanded. Colors run from Start to End along the Angle (0 degrees is top to bottom) and the curve reshapes how quickly they change. Whole Layout spans all visible Buttons on each monitor along the Angle; otherwise each window has its own gradient. Every selected color stop stays exact. Spread controls blend width and Scatter varies interior colors.
actionTooltips.button-theme.refill: Apply the ordered multi-color Surface gradient, with its angle and curve, to scoped Buttons in this program's currently open Pop-outs and Fans.
actionTooltips.button-theme.refill-colors: Sample the selected number of Gradient Colors from the current Theme image, show them as ordered gradient stops, and apply the gradient to scoped Buttons in this program's open Pop-outs and Fans.
actionTooltips.button-theme.scatter: Redistribute the currently present aggregate colors across the same live scanned Buttons using remembered hidden placement IDs.
actionTooltips.button-theme.toggle-text: Toggle all scoped Button label text in this program's open Pop-outs and Fans between black and white, replacing any text gradient, without changing Surface colors or saved skins.
actionTooltips.button-theme.settings: Apply separate Regular, Hover, and Active highlights and glow to this program's buttons. Regular applies only while neither hovered nor active. Saved themes include all three groups.
actionTooltips.button-theme.apply-text: Apply the Button Text gradient to every popped Button label in this program, independently of the fill. One Text Color keeps the labels solid; more colors run from Start to End along the text Angle and curve.
actionTooltips.button-theme.participation: Unchecked Buttons ignore gradients and bulk theme changes. Their individual colors remain editable and are saved with themes.
